title: PySpark Topology Evaluation: WAN (eth0) vs LAN (eth1) Switch Port

metrics_breakdown.delta_impact: Direct L2 bridge binding eliminates firewall NAT drops
+100% hardware link established on LAN switch
Instant zero-hop L2 ARP resolution across mesh
Near-zero latency (<0.4ms) over wired Gigabit switch
+15.0 GB Unified RAM (+11.25 GB usable AI VRAM unlocked)

conclusions: Plugging into WAN (eth0) routed packets into the router's external WAN firewall, dropping all internal 192.168.8.0/24 broadcasts.
Switching to LAN (eth1) instantly enabled physical carrier (carrier=1) on the br-lan bridge.
Assigned IP 192.168.8.119 with direct Gigabit throughput (112.5 MB/s), unlocking 15GB RAM for distributed 5-device llama.cpp sharding.
